summary.text: Michael Steger, who also goes by Mike, is the Republican candidate for Michigan House of Representatives District 6 in the November 3, 2026 general election, after advancing from the Republican primary on August 4, 2026.
According to Ballotpedia, his career has included working in business and managing Promethean Action.

paragraphs.text: Mike Steger was born in Kalamazoo, Michigan, and earned a bachelor's degree from the University of California at Santa Barbara in 1999.
Ballotpedia reports that he has been affiliated with the LaRouchePAC National Policy Committee and joined Lyndon LaRouche's 2004 presidential campaign.
Steger also ran for election to the U.S. House in Michigan's 11th Congressional District but did not appear on the ballot for the Republican primary on August 4, 2026.

In a 2025 Ballotpedia survey completed for that race, he said he ran a company for ten years that provided political intelligence reports and had spent the last five years building Promethean Action, a policy advocacy group.
He said in the survey that he is married and that his campaign's aims include re-shoring and rebuilding American industry.
